title: Noor and the Passage
author: J. M. Hartwell
blurb: Ulyana Nakamura, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
